# Closed callback interface defaults

Unmodified Kotlin/JVM8 parent and compatibility-child output retains a closed
contravariant Consumer callback Signature, a non-Java method name and an exact
inherited static default accessor. Genuine virtual calls, compatibility entries,
reflection and MethodHandle distinguish receiver overrides from lexical parent
default dispatch while invoking the callback on the original receiver.

Source and SDK-callback profiles compile every recovered Java unit and compare
all definitions and metadata/Exceptions, reported names/flags/helpers and genuine
D8 CLASS annotation loss. Frozen observers check four long values, raw float
bits, callback/receiver identity, nulls, effects and callback/trace failures.
Twenty independently compiled wrong callbacks and virtual redispatch must fail.
